settings.heading: Fit matters. Here's how to get it right now.
settings.text: A glove that's half a size out loses you grip and feel. Padding in the wrong place doesn't protect anything. So we treat sizing as part of the product, not an afterthought.

settings.label: Phase 1
settings.title: Apparel & protection sizing
settings.text: Charts for our kit and protection, measured from production samples — plus honest advice when you're between sizes.

settings.label: Phase 2
settings.title: Glove sizing help
settings.text: A hand-measurement tool and brand-by-brand advice, so you buy the right size of whatever glove you choose.

settings.label: Phase 3
settings.title: Personal glove fit
settings.text: When we make our own gloves, we want to fit them from your saved hand measurements. Not before we can do it properly.

settings.heading: Jerseys, shorts & pants
settings.intro: Body measurements, not garment measurements. Measure over light clothing.
settings.advice: Between sizes? For padded shorts and pants, size down if you're slim — pads must sit tight on the hip to stay in place when you dive. For jerseys, size up if you wear a base layer underneath.

settings.heading: Youth sizes
settings.advice: Go by height and chest, not age. Kids grow fast, but padding that's too big slides off the hip — don't size up more than one.

settings.question: I'm between glove sizes.
settings.answer: Negative-cut gloves fit tighter; go up half a size if you prefer comfort. Flat and roll-finger cuts have more room; stay at your measured size. If your fingertips touch the end of the glove, it's too small.

settings.question: Do sizes differ between brands?
settings.answer: Yes — by up to half a size. Treat our calculator as a starting point and always check the brand's own chart.

settings.question: Can you save my sizes?
settings.answer: If you have an account, you can save your sizes and fit preferences (hand measurement, preferred cut, surfaces, position) so we can recommend the right size next time.

settings.question: Something doesn't fit.
settings.answer: Non-custom items can be exchanged for a different size. See our returns policy. We'll ask what was wrong with the fit — that's how we improve our charts.
